Class Booking

java.lang.Object
lt.viko.eif.imazolevska.rehearsalbooking.entity.Booking
@Entity public class Booking extends Object
A booking of a room made by a band for a specific time. Mapped to the "bookings" database table.

      protected Booking()

    • Booking

      public Booking(Band band, Room room, LocalDateTime startTime, LocalDateTime endTime, BigDecimal price)
      Creates a new active booking. The price is calculated in the service layer and passed in ready.
      Parameters:
      band - the band that makes the booking
      room - the booked room
      startTime - the start of the rehearsal
      endTime - the end of the rehearsal
      price - the total price of the booking
